race.comment: DREYMON (4) battled away well enough when finishing sixth in provincial company at Newcastle-Beaumont just over 2 weeks ago, and his good form prior all came at this level. He has a handy gate and is expected to be among the hardest to beat in this. WANDJAD (3) finished ahead of the top pick in the same race when having his second start of a new prep. He is peaking at the right time and has won his only start here. Each-way value. READY AND LUCKY (1) is a consistent mare at this level in this area, and with the aid of a 2kg claim, she is set to put her best hoof forward. Include in all top 4 combos. EXPLOSIVE TYCOON (2) has been edging towards an overdue win this prep, and his effort for second in a tougher grade was solid enough for this more modest assignment. Stick with him. NIKODY'S BINKS (8) has been a beaten favourite in 2 starts since leading all the way to win his maiden at Taree in late June. He cops a tough gate but is worth another chance.
